_comment: RetroDiffusion prompts for every Baking item icon (tools/art/rd_icons.py). Prompts describe the subject only; the style handles the pixel-art look. `zh` is the Traditional Chinese name for review sheets. Entries marked from_harvest reuse the picked icon of the same item from Kaleidoscope Harvest (copied into art/icons) so items shared across the series look the same.
